claimGrading.use: not reset intent (low; cleansing moderate anyway)

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): defining anionic is Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2, ether/sulfonate type), buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) and Coco-Glucoside (11), no prominent reinforcing strong anionic.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Olefin sulfonate is a fairly strong cleanser; rich refatting/oil load (7, 8, 14, 16) argues the other way. Neither moves the C1 convention.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High (C2 met via payload-lipid substitution): prominent payload lipids Cocos Nucifera Oil (7) and Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (8) take the early-silicone place; cationic polymers Polyquaternium-10 (13), Polyquaternium-7 (15), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (18); pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (21); humectants Glycerin (5), Panthenol (10). Film former Polyimide-1 (12) and weak refatters (14, 16) add routes. W-RICH also holds.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; all deposition routes sit after Sodium Chloride (6), so each is likely at low level; three light polymers rather than one strong system.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: several converging deposition families (two prominent plant oils, three cationic polymers, a film former, weak refatters) make noticeable residue plausible, but there is no silicone, every route sits after the salt, and an effective buffered olefin-sulfonate chassis gives ordinary reset.
weightPotential.counterSignal: W-RICH with moderate reset; number of converging families argues toward high (N-ALT neighbor high).
